dimensions.name: age_band
dimensions.expr:
CASE WHEN age < 18 THEN '0-17' WHEN age < 30 THEN '18-29' WHEN age < 45 THEN '30-44'
     WHEN age < 60 THEN '45-59' WHEN age < 75 THEN '60-74' ELSE '75+' END

dimensions.name: gender
dimensions.expr: CASE gender WHEN 'M' THEN 'Male' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Female' ELSE 'Unknown' END

dimensions.name: risk_segment
dimensions.expr:
CASE WHEN critical_test_count > 0 THEN '1 High Risk (critical result)'
     WHEN abnormal_test_count > 0 THEN '2 Elevated (abnormal result)'
     WHEN total_tests > 0 THEN '3 Normal results'
     ELSE '4 No tests' END

dimensions.name: day_type
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END
